## Motivation

DP attention can pad the local query/top-k layout for downstream MLP/EP communication while keeping request metadata compact. The decode transform therefore has two intentional row domains:

### Purpose

In P/D disaggregation with NixlConnector, the decode-side handover (prefill
emits token#1 → client receives token#1) costs ~197ms p50 on our 3P1D setup,

title: [NPU][BugFix] Avoid M-RoPE recompilation for variable sequence lengths
body:
## Motivation

On Ascend NPU, Qwen3-VL workloads with variable prompt and image lengths can trigger repeated Triton compilation during prefill.

The NPU preparation path calls:

```text
get_cos_sin_with_position
  -> apply_interleaved_rope_triton
  -> apply_interleaved_rope_kernel
```

`apply_interleaved_rope_kernel` currently declares the runtime sequence length `S` as `tl.constexpr`. As a result, every previously unseen sequence length creates a separate Triton specialization:

```text
S=112 -> compile
S=148 -> compile
S=205 -> compile
S=311 -> compile
...
```

## Summary

Add INT8 and FP8 E4M3 SSM-cache dtypes for FlashInfer ReplaySSM.

- Store one FP32 decode scale per `(head, head_dim)`.
- Update quantized state and scale together across prefill and decode.
- Keep convolution state and ReplaySSM ring buffers at their existing dtypes.
- Preserve stochastic rounding for FP8 through the existing Mamba SSU seed and Philox-round controls.
